hypothesis: The integration of agentic AI into clinical trial design can significantly enhance the efficiency and accuracy of trial processes by automating complex tasks such as participant selection, eligibility criteria assessment, and data analysis, ultimately leading to improved trial outcomes and faster scientific discoveries. This hypothesis is supported by evidence that agentic AI systems can streamline workflows in scientific research, including literature reviews and experimental designs, while also addressing challenges related to data categorization and feature completeness in clinical trials [2503.08979:1][2503.08979:7][autoct-clinical:23][autoct-clinical:19][autoct-clinical:15].
